---
title: "Publications"
subtitle: "Articles published in journals with an impact factor above 10"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

Selected publications from the team in journals with an impact factor above
**10**, over the **2019–2024** evaluation period.

Across that period the team produced more than **480 references** in all
journals, including 25 original research articles and 61 clinical articles as
first or last authors.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How this list is built

It is generated from the team's HCERES bibliographic record. That record has no
impact-factor column, so the filter is applied to the journal name using a
lookup table based on recent JCR values.

The threshold is a single number: **IF > 20** would reduce the list to about
thirty references, **IF > 5** would push it beyond three hundred.

A few journals sit just below the cut and are therefore absent:
*Haematologica* (8.2), *HemaSphere* (7.6), *Blood Advances* (7.4),
*eClinicalMedicine* (9.6), *PNAS* (9.4).
:::
